name: webhook.site Frontend
description: (Frontend) A website to generate unique, random URLs that you can use to test and debug Webhooks and HTTP requests, as well as to create your own workflows.
requires:
Requires a separate Redis database and "webhook.site Backend" (also available in Community Applications).

        You must enter a container console and run the following command upon each startup:

        `sed -i -e 's/laravel-echo-server:6001/${BACKEND_SERVER_HOST}:${BACKEND_SERVER_PORT}/g' /etc/nginx/conf.d/nginx.conf`

variables.name: Server Host
variables.description: Hostname for the backend server. Replace with IP address of the backend server.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: Application URL. Replace with IP and port. Port must match Web UI Port

variables.name: Redis Host
variables.description: Redis host. Replace with IP address of Redis server.

variables.name: App Environment
variables.description: Application environment. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: App Debug
variables.description: Application debug mode. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: App Log
variables.description: Application log level. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Database connection
variables.description: Database connection type. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Broadcast Driver
variables.description: Broadcast driver. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Cache Driver
variables.description: Cache driver. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Queue Driver
variables.description: Queue driver. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Echo Host Mode
variables.description: Echo host mode. Not recommended to change.
